text: Dimitri's new puppy arrives Saturday morning, a cocker spaniel called Biscuit. He's taken the whole week off work to settle her in.
bethany says her mum's back in hospital, chest infection again. don't forget to text her tomorrow morning to see how the visit went
Zara turns 30 on 2 November 2026. She's obsessed with pottery at the moment, keeps talking about a wheel class in town. Voucher for that wd go down well.
Aisha's cat Pepper has to have two teeth out on Thursday at 10am. She's really anxious about the anaesthetic because Pepper's fourteen now.
colm broke his wrist at five a side lol. cast for 6 wks. no driving

Just got off the phone with Yusuf. His dad had a fall last night and fractured his hip, surgery is booked for Monday at 8am. Yusuf is driving up to Leeds tonight and staying with his sister Noor until at least the weekend. He sounded exhausted and properly rattled, kept apologising for being scattered. I should ring him Monday evening once his dad's out of theatre, and maybe drop a lasagne round for his wife Petra and the kids since she's on her own with them all week.
Lwazi - gluten free, hates mushrooms. birthday sometime in Jan, check
Georgia's daughter has chickenpox so the party on Saturday is off. Rebooking for the 14th at 2pm apparently.
pick up dog food and flea stuff on the way home
Bruno and his wife are celebrating their tenth anniversary in Lisbon, flying out 3 December. He wants a recommendation for a restaurant. Send him that list from Georgia's trip.
Amir mentioned his son Karim has his grade 3 piano exam on the 12th at half 9. Kid is terrified apparently. Remind me to send Amir a good luck message for him the night before.
Beatriz is into bouldering now, goes three times a week with her flatmate. Also learning Japanese.
Phoebe's rabbit died. Thumper. She had him eleven years. Should send her something, maybe flowers?
Noor - started at the vet practice on Kings Road in September, loves it. Has two cats, Fig and Olive.
Keisha's birthday drinks Friday at 7pm at the Crown. Bring card. Ebony is organising a whip round for a new record player, I owe her £15
Alessia's mum had her scan results today, all clear. Massive relief for the whole family.
Lachlan, aka Lachy, has a trial for the county rugby squad next Wednesday at 4. He says he's not bothered but he definitely is.

Voice note: okay so Ebony just told me that her brother Archie got diagnosed with type 1 diabetes last week, he's only nineteen, and he's really struggling with the injections and stuff. Ebony's going down to Bristol on Saturday to help him sort his kitchen out. Need to check in with her early next week, she's carrying a lot right now with her own job stuff too.
Joanna — dog Rolo had his first birthday yesterday. She made him a cake out of liver and peanut butter. Obviously.
oliver flu, off all week. said he'd send the deck when hes back, chase him fri if nothing
Rafael and Amara are expecting! Due in March 2027. Rafael's beside himself.

Kalani has been off for a month with her back, physio twice a week. Still in a lot of pain and fed up of being stuck at home. Text her this weekend, maybe offer to take her for a coffee once she can sit for longer.
Archie wants a new set of drumsticks and a practice pad, his birthday is 19 November. Ask his mum which brand.

Met Olga for lunch. Her mum is moving in with them after Christmas because her dementia's getting worse, they're converting the dining room into a bedroom for her. Olga sounds overwhelmed with it all, she's already cut down to three days at the library. Her husband Emil is being great apparently, and his sister Dorota is helping with the paperwork for carers. Olga's birthday is 15 January 2027, worth planning something nice.
Abigail got the puppy! Golden retriever, Honey. Collected her Sunday afternoon. Puppy training class starts 8 November 2026, Saturdays at 11.
Thinking of booking the vet for Mango's jabs, Tuesday at 5:30 if they have it.
Karim had his tonsils out on Friday, eating nothing but ice lollies. Back at school in a week or so.
Spoke to Emil about the cycling thing. He's doing a 100k charity ride for the hospice on 17 May 2027 in memory of his grandad. Must sponsor him.
Dorota's cat went missing Tuesday night, still not back. She's put posters up all round the estate. She's in bits.
lucy - into true crime podcasts, collects vintage teapots, allergic to cats. birthday 4 april
Petra said her son Oliver sprained his ankle at football yesterday afternoon. Hospital till 11pm. He has a match on the 25th he's now going to miss, gutted.
Dimitri, Bethany and I sorted the secret santa. I've got Zara. She's been dropping hints about a fancy candle from that shop in Shoreditch.
Aisha's little one, Lucy, is in hospital with bronchiolitis. They admitted her this morning at 6. Aisha's husband is with her overnight and Aisha's doing days. Don't forget to message her tonight.
Colm's mum Mrs Murphy turns 80 on the 9th. Big family lunch at the golf club, Sunday at 1pm. I'm doing the cake.
Yusuf's surgery went fine apparently. His dad's home on Friday morning if all goes to plan.
Lwazi's dog Duma had a seizure this morning and they rushed him to the emergency vet. Waiting on bloods. Lwazi is shaken. I need to call him after work to see what the vet said.

Georgia's 40th is the weekend of 5 December 2026. She said no presents but she's been on about wanting a proper espresso machine for months, ever since her old one died. Maybe go in with Bruno and Amir? Bruno said he'd be up for it. Amir is harder to pin down, his dad being in hospital and all. Message the group tomorrow morning and suggest £50 each.
Bruno's hamster died. Kids are devastated. Funeral in the garden Saturday morning, they've made a little headstone.
Beatriz has a hospital appointment about her knee Wednesday 28 October at 2:15. She's worried it's going to mean surgery. Ask her how it went Thursday.
Phoebe got engaged to Lachlan!!! Wedding probably summer 2028. Must send flowers.
amir's dad - stroke last week. stable now but in hospital. amir going back and forth to birmingham every day. he's exhausted
keisha mentioned her daughter is starting nursery on monday, she's more nervous than the kid tbh
New kitten at Alessia's! Tabby called Gnocchi. Ten weeks old. Their older cat is NOT impressed.
Need to post Lachlan's birthday card by Wednesday, it's on Saturday the 24th.
Ebony's into Formula 1 big time, supports McLaren. Would love paddock tickets one day, obviously not happening, but a McLaren hoodie might.

Had a long catch up with Joanna on the phone tonight. Her husband Rafael has been signed off work with stress since the start of October and she says he's barely sleeping, plus their eldest has glandular fever so she's off school too. Joanna's holding it all together but sounded worn out. She asked if I could have the younger one on Saturday 31 October from about 10am so she can take Rafael to his GP appointment. I said yes. Remind me to ring her Friday evening to confirm times.
Oliver's grandad passed away on Sunday. Funeral is 6 November 2026 at 11am, St Mary's. Oliver and his partner Kalani are flying back from Spain for it.

Amara's parrot Rio turns 25 next month. They're throwing it a party. Yes really. Saturday 14 November 2026 from 3pm, fancy dress optional, Rafael is making a bird-safe cake. Amara says Rio's into anything shiny so I could take a little mirror toy as a present, which is hilarious. Need to tell her by Friday if I'm coming.
Archie Chen, Dr Chen now technically, said his mum has shingles. He's covering her shop until she's better.
Olga has her MRI on Tuesday 3 November at 7:40am. Pretty sure she said she'd rather nobody fussed. Just send a quick text the day after.
Gym 7am tomorrow then dentist at 10:30. Car MOT the 30th.

Abigail's son Emil is having grommets fitted in January 2027, probably the week of the 11th though the date's not confirmed yet. He's had about six ear infections since the summer and has been struggling to hear in class. She's nervous about the general anaesthetic but says the ENT consultant was brilliant and explained everything. I should ask her nearer the time whether she needs a lift to the hospital.
Karim (Kaz) wants to get into fly fishing. Dropping big hints about waders for his birthday.
Dorota and her partner Petra are taking their dog Bear to the Lake District for a week from the 2nd. First holiday with him.

Lucy's mum was taken into A&E last night with chest pains. Turned out to be a panic attack thank god, she's home now. Lucy's going to stay with her for a few days. I should check in on Lucy over the weekend, she's had a rough few months what with the breakup and everything.

Zara's dog Pickle ate a sock, of all things. They spotted it on Saturday night when he wouldn't eat and kept being sick, x-ray Sunday confirmed it. Op on Monday afternoon to remove it, £1200 and the insurance excess is huge. On top of that her landlord's selling the flat. She's not having a good month at all. Drop round with wine Tuesday.
Colm's daughter Alessia is going to uni in Galway next September. Proud dad.
Bethany's dad's knee replacement got postponed again, now March 2027. He's in agony in the meantime and she's raging at the NHS.
Thought for Noor's birthday on 21 November 2026: she mentioned she's run out of that lavender bath oil. Easy win.
Followed up with Dimitri re the puppy. Biscuit's settled in fine but chewed through the TV cable on Tuesday. He's booked her in for puppy class Thursday at 6pm.
